svg.aria-label: Horizontal log-scale bar chart of latency numbers: L1 cache 0.5 ns, branch mispredict 5 ns, L2 cache 7 ns, mutex 100 ns, main memory 100 ns, compress 1 KB 10 µs, send 2 KB over 1 Gbps 20 µs, read 1 MB from memory 250 µs, data-center round trip 500 µs, disk seek 10 ms, read 1 MB from network 10 ms, read 1 MB from disk 30 ms, California–Netherlands round trip 150 ms.
svg.title: Latency numbers every programmer should know
